systemStatus.headline: SUN SEP 20, 7:15 AM PT. Three things landed since the 4 AM run. SALES: Sat Sep 19 is in from the GROUP summary -- net $6,869.35 on 278 guests / 180 orders -- and it is a SOFT SATURDAY. It came in BELOW Friday (net -1.5%, guests -4.1%, orders -3.2%) and well under the roughly $8,988 4-Saturday average. Saturday is normally the biggest day of the week; this one wasn't. Ticket size was actually FINE -- $24.71/guest and $38.16/order, both better than Friday -- so this is a traffic problem, not a tab problem. And the labour offset that rescued Friday REVERSED: 21.4% of net ($1,470.04) vs 17.7% Friday, roughly $238 more labour on fewer covers. Discounts improved to $230.00 / 3.2% of gross from Friday's 4.2%. Refunds $0.00, 11 voids, 0 open orders, Grant Danely auto-clocked out. The single-location DETAIL email is still pending (~7:40 AM PT), so dayparts, revenue centres and the Sat Sep 12 comparison are not in yet. SCHEDULE: Sun Sep 20 roster is LIVE -- 10 employees / 11 shifts / 49.25 hours, 0 uncovered, 0 OT, 0 off, the lightest day of the stretch. The barback is BACK. But the kitchen is ONE COOK DEEP FOR A NINTH STRAIGHT DAY, and there is NO MANAGER on today's schedule at all. ADS -- THE GOOD NEWS: Google Ads spent $39.88 against a $40.00/day budget, ENDING A 10-DAY OVERSPEND STREAK, and it did it while impressions ROSE to 779. Avg CPC nearly halved, $2.77 to $1.48; CTR 3.47%, 27 clicks, 1.00 conversion pending. Both live campaigns are still 'all ads limited by policy' -- that policy block is now the binding constraint. Note BHC Coffee | Search | P1 Launch sits PAUSED while Google's own banner credits it with 84 conversions in 30 days. YELP: live, $269.22 Sep 1-19 ($14.17/day vs a $13/day setting), 102 ad leads at $4.41, CPC $1.26, 74% impression share. Audience size STILL 'Limited' for a SIXTH run. Yelp's Reviews tab now flags 4 items needing attention, up from 3. TRIPADVISOR: zero emails, nothing to report. Reviews, payroll and the GBP management request were not re-read this run and are carried forward from 4 AM -- the 13 + 2 unreplied Google reviews and Donald Clay's botulism allegation are still open.

unanswered.text: Terrible experience. The service at the bar was indifferent - the bartender acted as though he were doing me a favor by serving me. The food is far too expensive for the quality and presentation. I ordered a grilled chicken wedge salad and received, quite literally, a huge chunk of iceberg lettuce.
unanswered.context: Surfaced by SpotHopper 2026-09-16T19:29Z. No businessprofile-noreply notification for this one -- caught via SpotHopper only. Same reviewer also uploaded photos to the profile Sep 16 21:18Z.

The wedge should come dressed, garnished and portioned properly - if it went out as a bare chunk of iceberg, that's on us, and I'm talking to both the bar and the kitchen about it. I'd like to make it right if you'll give us another shot. - Joal, Owner

unanswered.name: Andy Watts
unanswered.text: We had fish and chips, oh my days, stunnning. And great service too. Best fish and chips Ive experienced.
unanswered.draftReply: Andy, best fish and chips you've had is a hell of a thing to hear -- our cooks will be insufferable now. Thanks for calling out the service too. Come back hungry. -- Joal, The Brewhouse

unanswered.name: Greg Quinn
unanswered.text: The Brewhouse has amazing, fresh food menu selections at very reasonable prices and the adult beverages hit the spot. I am a pilsner/lager guy and the one I had was so good I ordered one more. I thought the nachos were on point and the Schnitzel comes with 3 sauce options that are gourmet. Fresh seafood will be my go to next time. The staff is awesome and I even got to meet one of the owners who informed me The Brewhouse is the longest-running bar in SB, and soon they'll be able to craft their own spirits!
unanswered.draftReply: Greg, a pilsner guy going back for a second round is the highest praise a brewery can get. Glad the nachos and the schnitzel sauces hit the mark too, and thanks for the kind words about the crew. Come back for the seafood and we'll pour you a cold one. -- Joal, The Brewhouse

unanswered.name: M
unanswered.draftReply: Hi M, thanks for stopping by and for the rating. Three stars tells us something was just okay, and we'd like to know what so we can fix it. If you're up for it, email us at mojobrewhouse@gmail.com. Hope to see you again. -- Joal, The Brewhouse

unanswered.name: Luke Mayer (Cheez boi)

The everything bagel was exceptional, perfectly toasted to light crunch on the outside with a soft an chewy interior and a generous topping of melting butter alongside a prodigal portion of cream cheese. The breakfast burrito was simply exquisite, containing the perfect ratio of scrambled egg, bacon, avocado, sour cream, breakfast potato, cheese, and salsa on the side.
unanswered.draftReply: Luke, that may be the most thorough bagel review we have ever received and we are keeping it. Glad the burrito ratio landed right too. Come back hungry.
